chunks: And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Whoever trims his nails and cuts his moustache every Friday, then says 'Bismillah wa billahi wa ala millat Rasulillah', he is granted for every trim the freeing of a slave from the progeny of Ismail.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for trimming nails and moustache on Friday in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) linking the physical act of grooming—specifically trimming nails and moustache on Fridays—to spiritual liberation, promising the reward of freeing a slave from the progeny of Ismail for each snip. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition) and the integration of bodily purity with ritual devotion, transforming mundane hygiene into an act of worship that mirrors the Sunnah of the Prophet (PBUH).
